registry.description: Spiritual powers is a placeholder category for the non-human spiritual beings described in Scripture — angels, demons, principalities, powers, and the various named beings that populate the biblical world. This category does not have its own Hebrew or Greek term but is a synthesis point for the programme: understanding the inner life of the human person requires understanding the spiritual environment within which that person exists, including the beings that can affect, inhabit, or oppose them. [Special handling — cross-registry synthesis placeholder.]

terms.medium_def:
An angel in the Old Testament; 
called Satan or "accuser" (KJV= Satan) (שָׂטָן); or "worthless" (KJV= Belial; NIV= "troublemakers") or "worthless" (KJV= Belial; NIV= "wicked") or "worthless" (KJV= Belial; NIV= "evil") or "worthless" (KJV= Belial; NIV= "scoundrel") or "scoundrel" (KJV= Belial) (בְּלִיַּ֫עַל); or Beelzebul (KJV= Beelzebub) (Βεελζεβούλ); or Belial (Βελίαλ); or Satan (Σατάν); or [ ] (KJV= Satan) or Satan (Σατανᾶς) § 
This name means adversary, one who withstands
1a) adversary (in general-personal or national)
♣2) superhuman adversary
2a) Satan (as noun pr)
